name: Descent of the Void
body:
School divination [void]; Level psychic 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

Casting Time 6 hours

Components V, S, DF

Range personal

Target self

Duration special (see text)

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

One of the pinnacles of Void magic for mortals, this spell results in a practitioner of Void magic securing an audience with a unique and inscrutable cosmic entity or intelligence that is somewhat benevolent. Some sages suggest that this entity is composed entirely of the void element, borne from the cosmic awareness of the nothingness from which everything is formed.

During the casting time, you must chant and meditate on beyond the ego. Upon completing this spell, you gain an audience with the aforementioned Void entity as if you had cast the contact other plane spell. If you can speak and understand Celestial, this Void entity responds to you as if you achieved the results of “Outer Plane, greater deity,” with no Intelligence check required to avoid the decrease to your Intelligence and Charisma. Otherwise, the audience ends with no answers given and you must make an Intelligence check DC 16 to avoid having your Intelligence and Charisma reduced to 8 for 5 weeks, losing any spellcasting ability for the same duration.

Once the audience ends, you are affected by a heal spell (however, this never removes any decrease to your Intelligence and Charisma dealt by the Void entity for not speaking celestial) and your ki pool is replenished to maximum capacity. The Void entity will not allow mortals to contact it more than once a week (this frequency is based on the normal flow of time in the Prime Material world). Those who seek to circumvent or defy this decree are instead affected by a feeblemind spell with no save, immunity, or any other defense (including SR) that would otherwise mitigate or negate the spell’s effects.
